Let $V(t)$ be the volume of water in the tank at time $t$ minutes.
The tank fills at a rate of 12 litres per minute and drains at a rate of 5 litres per minute.
The net rate of filling is $12 - 5 = 7$ litres per minute.
The tank has a capacity of 480 litres.
The volume of water in the tank at time $t$ is given by $V(t) = (12 - 5)t = 7t$.
We want to find the time $t$ when the tank is full, i.e., $V(t) = 480$.
So, $7t = 480$.
$t = \frac{480}{7} \approx 68.57142857$ minutes.
Rounding to two decimal places, we have $t \approx 68.57$ minutes.

Final Answer: The final answer is $\boxed{68.57}$
